title: Ayanokoji vs Ryuen Analysed like Chess | Classroom of the Elite
timingStatus: Search windows in the rejected Slash Kyubi candidate. Re-time against the clean source before rendering.

moves.trigger: After Ayanokoji explains the surveillance camera was disabled.
moves.title: Disabling the camera
moves.comment: Ayanokoji removes the camera before the confrontation. Ryuen sees an easy target. The target has already prepared the room.

moves.trigger: After the four-on-one threat and Ayanokoji's response.
moves.title: Trusting the numbers
moves.comment: Four against one looks winning. Ryuen counts bodies instead of checking the opponent. There is a small problem with his calculation.

moves.trigger: After the group attackers are neutralized; keep the actual fight uninterrupted.
moves.title: Breaking the formation
moves.comment: Ayanokoji deals with the attackers in sequence. The numerical advantage never becomes a coordinated attack. Ryuen's backup is disappearing.

moves.title: Repeating the same attack
moves.comment: Another attacker steps in, and the same plan fails again. Ryuen has watched the counters. He still has no second strategy.

moves.trigger: After Ryuen frames fear and violence as the deciding advantage.
moves.title: Betting everything on fear
moves.comment: Ryuen expects pain to make everyone obey. His whole strategy needs a frightened opponent. Ayanokoji is not providing one.

moves.trigger: After a complete exchange exposes Ayanokoji's lack of the expected emotional response.
moves.title: Turning the weapon around
moves.comment: Ayanokoji stays unreadable while Ryuen loses control. The man who built his position on fear is becoming the only frightened player.

moves.trigger: After Ryuen's defeat is clearly shown; do not freeze on an unfinished punch.
moves.title: Finding out too late
moves.comment: Ryuen finally learns what fear feels like. Unfortunately, this is the part where the lesson stops being theoretical.

ending: Resume the original scene and let the Karuizawa resolution close the episode. Exclude every uploader end card.
